newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-STRUGGLING RAYO FIRE MANAGER AHEAD OF REAL CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRUGGLING RAYO FIRE MANAGER AHEAD OF REAL CLASH.

text.p: Spanish first division side Rayo Vallecano have fired manager Paquito Garcia less than 48 hours before meeting mighty neighbours Real Madrid.
After a good start to the season Paquito has seen his side slip into the danger zone by taking just one point from a possible 18.
New coach Fernando Zambrano, previously an assistant at the club, will have to fight not just relegation but also take on high-flying Real Betis in the Spanish Cup quarter-finals.
